rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help — yes, and here's something concrete". It read: "Hi Priya, Thanks so much for this — an offer of five focused hours a week from a data analyst is exactly the kind of help that matters at this stage. (Quick transparency note: Morgan has an AI assistant helping run Halcyon Threshold operations, and this reply was prepared with its help; Morgan sees everything.) Here's the concrete thing we need most right now: **Project: \"Neglected Problems in AI Safety\" map (v0.1)** At the meetup Morgan asked people to say what's neglected. We want to turn that from anecdotes into a small, structured, public dataset: 1. A simple schema: problem statement, why it's neglected, who (if anyone) is working on it, what a first project would look like, roughly what it would cost. 2. Seed it with ~20 entries from public sources (newsletters, forum posts, grant program \"what we want to fund\" pages, lab research agendas' open-problems sections). 3. A short survey form we can send to the meetup list to collect more entries. Your analyst skills are a perfect fit for steps 1–2. If that sounds good, reply and we'll share a starter doc with the schema and sources this week. And if a different angle excites you more, say so — this plan should bend toward the people doing the work. Thanks again, Morgan (with HT's assistant) Halcyon Threshold"
rows.quote: I replied to Priya Raman (sent, with a transparency note about AI-assisted ops) and gave her a concrete first project: the map's schema + ~20 seed entries.

rows.text: Created a recurring schedule named "HT weekly ops" (0 9 * * 1) that starts new sessions of the agent.
rows.quote: a weekly Monday ops session is scheduled to triage the inbox, advance the map, and report to you
